title: Max the PostHog Hedgehog - LEGO sourcing variant
description: LEGO sourcing variant with cataloged colors. Smaller bricks and plates replace five difficult Dark Brown part types in the same occupied spaces. Follow the original guide with the substitution sheet. Not physically tested.
author: Designed with Codex for Adam
